evidence: Official member record (nprlapfmaufmqytet DAESU=20) lists 제20대 경북 경산시 새누리당. 자유한국당 took that name in 2017, after his first recorded vote on 2016-06-09.
Official member record (nprlapfmaufmqytet DAESU=21) lists 제21대 인천 동구미추홀구을 무소속. 국민의힘 took that name in September 2020, after his first recorded vote on 2020-06-08.

Elected on the 더불어시민당 proportional list (ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/양정숙, accessed 2026-09-26). The official member record (nprlapfmaufmqytet DAESU=21) gives the post-merger name 더불어민주당. ALLNAMEMBER records 무소속, the status she held after being expelled.

Elected on the 더불어시민당 proportional list and expelled before the merger, then returned to 기본소득당 (ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/용혜인, accessed 2026-09-26). The official member record gives the post-merger name 더불어민주당.

Elected as 더불어시민당 proportional candidate no. 6 and expelled before the term began, then returned to 시대전환 (ko.wikipedia.org/wiki/조정훈_(1972년), accessed 2026-09-26). The official member record gives the post-merger name 더불어민주당.
